description: Beat This (Foscarin, Schlüter, and Widmer, ISMIR 2024), the final0 checkpoint: every beat and downbeat with the package's minimal postprocessor (no dynamic Bayesian network), so the metrical level is the model's and nothing asserts a meter. Decodes the content again at its own rate with soundfile. Runs under the operator's beatthis-python, with the checkpoint the operator configures as beatthis-checkpoint, so the archive's environment never imports PyTorch. CPU only, a fixed thread count.

parameters.decode: soundfile.read float32, both channels, at the file's own rate (beat_this resamples to 22050 Hz mono)

beats.description: every beat the model finds, at the model's own metrical level

downbeats.description: the beats the model marks as downbeats; their spacing is not a meter

median_bpm.description: 60 over the median beat interval; 0 with fewer than two beats
